items.title: AI theme has 'a long way to run': Strategist
items.summary: Yahoo Finance host Jared Blikre and The Wealth Consulting Group Chief Market Strategist Talley Léger discuss market leadership shifting from tech concentration to diffusion, explaining why investors must take a 'leap of faith' on massive AI capital spending by tech hyperscalers like Alphabet (GOOG), Meta (META), and Microsoft (MSFT).

items.title: Explainer-How could New Mexico's $567 million ruling change Meta?
items.summary: Aug 7 (Reuters) - A New Mexico state court ordered Meta Platforms, owner of Facebook and Instagram, to make major changes to its platforms and pay the largest sum yet in a growing wave of U. litigation over claims that social media harms young people.
